title: Oregon Chief Justice Order 2011-034 — Order to Approve Out-of-Cycle Amendment of Twenty-Fifth Judicial District (Yamhill County) Supplementary Local Rule 1.151
text:
In the Matter of Approving Out-of­Cycle
Amendment of Twenty-Fifth
Judicial District (Yamhill County)
Supplementary Local Rule 1.151
CHIEF JUSTICE ORDER
No.11-034
ORDER TO APPROVE OUT-OF-CYCLE
AMENDMENT OF TWENTY-FIFTH JUDICIAL
DISTRICT (YAMHILL COUNTY)
SUPPLEMENTARY LOCAL RULE 1.151
I HEREBY ORDER, pursuant to ORS 1.002, ORS 3.220(2)(b), and UTCR 1.050(2)(f), that:
1. Good cause has been shown and the time limits established by UTCR 1.050(2) are
waived for the amendment approved by this order.
2. Out-of-cycle amendment of Supplementary Local Rule 1.151 for the Twenty-Fifth
Judicial District (Yamhill County), as shown in Attachment A to this order, is approved.
Deleted wording is shown in [italics and brackets] and new wording is shown in
{underlined bold and braces}.
3. The Twenty-Fifth Judicial District shall provide notice of this amendment to state and
local bar organizations, appropriate state and local agencies, and appropriate business
partners in a manner that the Presiding Judge determines will give sufficient notice.
4. Pursuant to ORS 3.220(2)(b), this amendment takes effect 30 days after a certified copy
of the rule amended by this order is filed in the Office of the State Court Administrator.
5. This order takes effect immediately.
sf-
Dated this I day of September, 2011.

CJO No. 11-034
ATTACHMENT A
